Use case: illustration-story. Create the NEXT finished vertical comic page in Nightglass Courier, EXACTLY THREE full-width horizontal tiers stacked top to bottom with slim clean gutters. No inset panels. Reference 1 supplies original elegant anime drawing and inhabited navy city atmosphere, not the creature. Reference 2 supplies adult Aren identity and clothes, NOT objects he no longer carries. Reference 3 is the immediately preceding selected three-tier scene: preserve its Aren, ONE right-hand crescent sword/cyan POMMEL ring, earlier torn LOWER HEM, hidden black envelope, lower landing and black anchor post. This is the continuation AFTER the bottom tier of reference 3. Do not repeat the handoff or draw Pell on this page. No creatures, no Sera figure, no rigs. NO TEXT OR BALLOONS OR NUMBERS anywhere. Keep the upper 22 percent of each tier as calmer unobstructed environment for later editable dialogue, with faces and action safely below.

Draw thin controlled anime outlines, appealing angular adult face, swept midnight hair and gray eyes, ivory long-sleeved waist jacket over black high neck, black slim trousers/boots, red courier cord and original cream dispatch wallet at belt. Broad navy/cyan shadows, sparse warm domestic lamps, quiet matte stone, controlled detail. The same BLACK envelope with BROKEN SILVER-CIRCLE seal is fully concealed INSIDE chest pocket at start. One sword held by anatomical RIGHT hand throughout; anatomical LEFT hand remains available. Preserve the existing ragged lower jacket hem in all three tiers.

TOP TIER, N1-34: medium-wide side, entire Aren from head to boots, visible landing and both line endpoints. Aren is arriving at the LOWER stone landing, feet just touching. He is braking with intense concentration, body slowing rather than striking. RIGHT fist holds crescent sword pointing DOWN-LEFT; ONE thin taut cyan line begins at the cyan POMMEL RING BEHIND RIGHT FIST and ends on the same stout BLACK metal landing post at picture right. Keep line origin separate from blade and wrist; both endpoints visible. Beside this post a projecting iron handrail tooth catches his anatomical LEFT sleeve at the ELBOW, making a single clear ragged tear. Show actual contact between tooth and white sleeve, no blood/wound. The LEFT arm is otherwise empty. Black envelope remains completely hidden inside chest. Existing lower hem tear persists. Show last active braking instant and boots reaching support, no duplicated body or motion ghosts.

MIDDLE TIER, N1-35: waist-up aftermath on the SAME lower landing, closed stair wicket behind him. He stands fully supported. Tether entirely OFF: no cyan line anywhere, pommel dark. One sword stays in his anatomical RIGHT hand lowered at his side. Aren looks down toward his torn anatomical LEFT elbow sleeve with a small rueful look; left arm relaxed and hand EMPTY. He does not touch his left elbow with his left hand. Show the same projecting tooth beside him and tear still present. Envelope remains hidden inside chest pocket. Prior hem tear retained. Leave calm upper-left space for an offscreen speaker later, but draw no speaker or balloon.

BOTTOM TIER, N1-36: medium frame face through upper thighs, enough to show torn lower hem AND torn anatomical LEFT elbow sleeve. Aren has retrieved the intact sealed BLACK envelope and holds it in his anatomical LEFT hand in front of his chest, checking the unbroken broken-silver-circle seal with obvious quiet relief. His anatomical RIGHT hand holds the lowered same crescent sword at his opposite side; pommel DARK, no line. Both tears persist, no blood, body stably on lower landing. Black envelope only here, never doubled with another black envelope or belt object. The original CREAM belt dispatch wallet is distinct and remains shut. Calm upper area for the short later dialogue. Do not draw interface upgrades or captions. Each tier is one successive moment: contact/tear while braking, line off inspecting sleeve, then black envelope retrieved safely.
